designationHistory.name: White River Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the White River Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 7173; it is now Dale Bumpers White River National Wildlife Refuge.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Dale Bumpers White River National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 7173—Establishing White River Migratory Waterfowl Refuge (Sep 04, 1935)

review.note: EO 7173, 1935-09-04 (Franklin D. Roosevelt). Draft gives Sept. 5, 1935; the order is dated Sept. 4, 1935.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Dale Bumpers White River National Wildlife Refuge was established on September 5, 1935 by President Franklin D.
